- reconcile the current "orphan" referrals from Partner Center

Could you confirm by EOD today whether Contoso can surface the tenant IDs and endorse the sprint? If yes, I'll post a short mutual action plan and lock meeting times.

Thanks —

Team —

Quick note on the matching heuristics I plan to run once we have Contoso's export. These are intentionally conservative so we minimize ownership disputes:

Primary match rules (in order):
- Tenant ID (GUID) exact match -> assign to seller mapped to that tenant in HubSpot / Partner Center
- Subscription billing ID exact match -> assign to billing contact's seller if tenant ambiguous
- Primary domain (email domain owner) + account display name fuzzy match -> assign as tentative and create a manual review ticket
- If multiple sellers map to the same tenant (duplicate consent issues), create an "ownership dispute" flag and escalate to regional sales lead for decision

Fallbacks / special cases:
- If Contoso indicates the account is a shared service tenant (multiple business units), we'll tag as "partner-managed" and leave for partner-led outreach rather than force a seller claim.
- For referrals > 120 days old with no contact info, auto-archive unless Contoso asks for extended review.

I'll capture these rules in Account_Match_Heuristics.md (attached) and run an initial pass the afternoon of Tue Jan 26. Ben — can you scope the HubSpot automation hooks to create the manual-review tickets and set the seller assignment field on matches?

-Vanessa
Head of Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Account_Match_Heuristics.md (text, stub)

On Tue, Jan 26, 2027 at 08:45 Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:

> 
> Quick note on the matching heuristics I plan to run once we have Contoso's export. These are intentionally conservative so we minimize ownership disputes:
> 
> Primary match rules (in order):
> - Tenant ID (GUID) exact match -> assign to seller mapped to that tenant in HubSpot / Partner Center
> - Subscription billing ID exact match -> assign to billing contact's seller if tenant ambiguous
> - Primary domain (email domain owner) + account display name fuzzy match -> assign as tentative and create a manual review ticket
> - If multiple sellers map to the same tenant (duplicate consent issues), create an "ownership dispute" flag and escalate to regional sales lead for decision

Agree with the approach. A couple of practical notes from implementing similar flows:

- HubSpot + Partner Center sync: we'll add a small middleware job that calls PC API for referral metadata (consent status, referral age) and then updates a custom HubSpot property "pc_owner_suggested". When pc_owner_suggested is empty after the pass, we open a manual review task.
- Template outreach: I'll draft a short seller outreach template we can use for consent requests (one-click DocuSign or Reply-All accept). That cuts manual steps.
- Edge automation: if a tenant has a single historical contact and that contact is active in HubSpot in last 180 days, we auto-assign. Otherwise manual review.

I'll prototype the middleware and drop a link to a runbook in the sheet by Thursday. Laura — once Ben drops the runbook, can you own the vendor approval step for the DocuSign flow?

-Ben
Principal RevOps Engineer
Redwood Inference
